Chapter 1163 - 25: Xuanhuang Mausoleum (Seeking Early Month’S Minimum Monthly Ticket)

Chapter 1163: Chapter 25: Xuanhuang Mausoleum (Seeking early month’s minimum monthly ticket)

When Lin Yuan first entered the Xuanhuang Universe, he did not send out incarnations to search far and wide.

He was worried about exposing the locations of the treasures and wonders recorded on the beast-skin map.

The outer regions of the Xuanhuang Universe, where most treasures and wonders are found, are extremely secretive.

Even for Lin Yuan, without the guidance of the beast-skin map, it would be difficult to find them in a short time.

The same goes for other Great Saints.

Sending out incarnations to search at this time would simply point the way for other Chaos Great Saints.

But now...

Throughout the Xuanhuang Universe, aside from Lin Yuan, there are only some Chaos Venerables.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, even if he sends out hundreds of incarnations, each can maintain strength close to a Chaos Realm Venerable.

Dealing with those Chaos Venerables is not a problem.

Of course, those Chaos Venerables also wouldn’t dare to contend with Lin Yuan.

Are you joking? Haven’t you seen the fate of the Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints?

...

Internal Universe.

While heading to the Xuanhuang Mausoleum, Lin Yuan also channeled a trace of his consciousness into his Internal Universe.

"I wonder if this Dark Sky Heart will have any effect on me."

Lin Yuan looked at the dark and deep crystal stone in front of him, while other Chaos Great Saints generally lack means comparable to the Dark Sky Domain.

As soon as the Dark Sky Domain was condensed, it surpassed the Black Light Domain of the Black Light Great Saint.

Thus, even if many Chaos Great Saints obtained the Dark Sky Heart, they wouldn’t consider if it was useful to them.

It is obvious that possessing such a method for suppressing and trapping enemies is what many Chaos Great Saints dream of.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint, in terms of pure combat power, is not weaker than the Black Light Great Saint, but the Black Light Great Saint looks down on him, considering him a mere brute.

What is the reliance?

Isn’t it the Black Light Domain?

Lin Yuan could suppress the Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and other eight Great Saints, relying on powers like the External Universe Domain.

Without the External Universe, even if Lin Yuan’s overall combat power surpasses the eight Chaos Great Saints, it would be difficult to suppress them all.

However, when it comes to domain space-time, Lin Yuan already has the External Universe, worrying whether the Dark Sky Heart would overlap with his methods.

"Let’s refine it and see."

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan immediately began to refine the heart.

A treasure of the unparalleled Great Saint level like the Dark Sky Heart is best used on oneself. As for trading it?

Unless it truly has no effect on him, Lin Yuan would not choose to trade it away.

Rumbling.

The vast cosmic force began refining that small, dark, and deep crystal stone, causing pure Dark Sky Origin Source to surge out.

This Dark Sky Origin Source is extremely magical and quickly absorbed and devoured by the Internal Universe.

"Useful."

Joy appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. As he slowly refined the Dark Sky Heart, he clearly felt the foundation of his Internal Universe being enhanced at a certain speed.

After hundreds of breaths.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

At this moment, the dark and deep crystal had completely disappeared, and simultaneously, the power of Lin Yuan’s Internal Universe had surged, increasing by at least twenty percent.

"A twenty percent increase in power, not bad."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Ordinary Chaos Great Saints refining the Dark Sky Heart would experience a power surge of several tens of times, reaching the level of peak Great Saints.

Yet Lin Yuan only increased his Internal Universe’s power by twenty percent... it seems less beneficial, but it’s important to note that Lin Yuan is substantially more powerful than ordinary Chaos Great Saints.

Different starting points naturally lead to different enhancements.

"If it were now, the Dual Origin Great Saint shouldn’t be able to escape my External Universe."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the Dual Origin Great Saint recklessly burned the power of dual-origin fusion, tearing a rift to the outside world, and thus managed to escape.

This left Lin Yuan rather regretful.

After all, that was ten billion chaos stones.

And the Dual Origin Great Saint certainly carried treasure weapons, making it not as simple as just ten billion chaos stones.

If it weren’t for safety, Lin Yuan really wanted to pursue and kill them.

...

The true form of Lin Yuan traversed the Xuanhuang Universe with impunity.

With the guidance of the beast-skin map, Lin Yuan was aware of and thus avoided some dangers in the Xuanhuang Universe, saving a lot of time.

Quickly.

Lin Yuan reached the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Universe.

It was empty here, and the surroundings were shrouded in strands of Xuanhuang Qi.

In the Xuanhuang Universe, such Xuanhuang Qi is everywhere, making Lin Yuan feel very comfortable. Within this omnipresent Xuanhuang Qi environment, the "Xuanhuang Physique" seemed to have returned to its origin.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan carefully observed his surroundings, a look of confusion on his face.

"Where’s the mausoleum?"

Comparing the beast-skin map, according to its instructions, this should be where the mausoleum is located, but currently, there are no traces of a mausoleum.

"Does it exist deep in space-time?"

Lin Yuan continued to observe, scanning through layers of space-time, but found nothing.

"This beast-skin map... shouldn’t be wrong."

Lin Yuan pondered, the authenticity of the beast-skin map had been verified multiple times.

Whether it was the Life Divine Stone on the Life Origin Star, or other various treasures and wonders, and the Dark Sky Heart, etc.

All matched the indications on the beast-skin map.

Moreover, Lin Yuan’s many incarnations were currently following the map’s guidance to gather numerous treasures and wonders in various regions.

This essentially confirmed the beast-skin map.

"Could it be that there are other conditions to enter the Xuanhuang Mausoleum?"

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred slightly.

Since it’s called a mausoleum, it’s certainly a place Xuanhuang valued, and it’s highly possible it’s not open to other Great Saints?
